A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 67-page paper. Text and rendered-page comparisons cover the main text, Appendices A–G, and final rank–MSE plots, with no material gaps.

before.justification: v4 reports original forecasting experiments for RRR, DWRR, and Root Purge, plus synthetic noise and root-recovery experiments in Section 5 and Appendix E.

after.justification: v5 retains these original benchmark and synthetic experimental results in Section 5 and Appendix E.

M1.justification: RRR and DWRR in Algorithms 1–2, the Root Purge objective in Equation 3, and the method variants documented in the appendices are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same ETT, Exchange, Weather, Traffic, Electricity, and M4 datasets, alongside the same synthetic forecasting and noise scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in corresponding main and appendix experiments, including the forecasting baselines, computational comparisons, and OLS versus gradient-based root-recovery comparisons.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, lookback windows, forecasting horizons, metrics, hyperparameter selection procedures, and experimental controls are unchanged in Section 5 and Appendix E.

E4.justification: Both retain identical analyses of singular values, noise robustness, data scaling, channel modeling, bias, rank and regularization sensitivity, higher-order purging, and stop-gradient versus full-gradient training.

E5.justification: The five-run reporting for Root Purge, single deterministic evaluation for RRR, error-bar reporting, and explanations for omitted uncertainty are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, rankings, qualitative findings, and plotted results match, including Tables 1–3, the experimental appendix tables, and the final rank–MSE curves.

T1.justification: The characteristic-root definitions, assumptions, noise-scaling results, regularization derivations, and proofs in Section 3 and Appendix D are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about characteristic-root analysis, structural regularization, noise robustness, and forecasting performance.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations and result interpretations are unchanged. Appendix F.1 retains the same limitations concerning nonlinear dynamics and insufficient expressivity with short lookback windows.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, hardware, computational measurements, baseline reproduction details, and code-access information are unchanged, including Appendix E and the reproducibility statement.

R1.justification: The cited works, related-work discussions in Section 2 and Appendix B.1, and positioning relative to prior forecasting and linear-system research are unchanged.

P1.justification: Page 1 expands the first affiliation from 'Bosch (China) Investment Co., Ltd.' to 'Bosch Center for AI (BCAI) & Bosch (China) Investment Co., Ltd.' The arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The remaining wording and document structure are identical.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, and layout are unchanged. The expanded affiliation remains on one line without reflowing page 1; rendered pages 2–67 are identical.

improvement.justification: v5 only expands an institutional affiliation and updates the arXiv version/date identification. The scientific content, evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and appendices are unchanged, so these administrative edits do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
